jobs.title: Security Analyst & Facility Security Officer (TS)
jobs.description:
Beyond SOF in Texas seeks a Security Analyst & FSO to manage IT and facility security programs, coordinate audits, and handle personnel clearances. The role requires knowledge of NISPOM, DFARS, and NIST, with responsibilities spanning incident response, security documentation, and regulatory compliance.

This position advises on security programs for government contracts, collaborates with HR, IT, Contracts, and BD teams, and may require CONUS travel while ensuring ongoing regulatory adherence.
